content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Unsafe Rust permits a narrow set of operations whose safety obligations the compiler cannot fully prove. Every unsafe boundary needs explicit invariants, valid initialization, correct aliasing, and compatible external contracts.

content_blocks.title: A reliable way to reason about it
content_blocks.text: For Undefined Behavior and Memory-Safety Invariants, write down the inputs, the guarantee you expect, and the boundary where that guarantee stops. Work through a minimal example first; then deliberately test one edge case. Treat every unsafe block as a contract with the reader: state the invariants, minimize its scope, and test the safe abstraction built around it.
